# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget.
Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

evidence.quote: key unlock

observations.why: The Zephyr integration is spoken of AS a key unlocking something — a thing functioning as another thing, not mere vividness.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Past-tense 'shipped' reports a completed, concrete event with a named artifact.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Plain factual assertion of a completed action; no ratification language or performed declarative that would elevate to decision, no hedging that would lower to notion.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Unhedged factual assertion with a superlative comparison; asserted as fact and defensible with data, but no performed settling or operational rule to reach decision.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Confident causal attribution stated as flat assertion; no hedging lowers it to notion, but no ratification or permanence language elevates it to decision or principle.

evidence.quote: We shipped

observations.why: The 'we' enacts communal-sharing — the team as an undifferentiated body that ships together.

evidence.quote: 23 points

observations.why: Velocity measured in points is proportionality — output quantified and compared against a benchmark ('highest this quarter').

evidence.quote: key unlock

observations.why: Framing an integration as the 'key unlock' casts it as the proportional lever — the single input that unlocked the outcome.

payload.rationale: This document is a new sprint retro (2026-08-04) that directly parallels the prior Sprint 4 Retro (2026-03-22): same 23-point velocity claim, same Zephyr integration as key unlock, same async decision widget feature. I expanded the prior retro sample, the Zephyr integration position, the velocity observation, the thesis-proven positions, the metric-anchoring style observation, the Zephyr rate-limit resolution, and the pricing position so the passes can detect whether this is a duplicate, an update, or a new retro building on the same themes. I also expanded the AntiSlack positioning narrative and its child positions (anti-pattern, product category, target market) because the async decision widget is the product embodiment of that narrative — the passes need the positioning context to bind the feature mention correctly. No areas were deliberately excluded; the document is short and touches a tight cluster of already-mapped concepts.

positions.name: Sprint4DeliveryEvidence
positions.frame: what concrete signals mark this sprint's delivery as a validated success?
positions.why: All three expressions are flat, past-tense, unhedged assertions (conviction: claim throughout) that together supply the evidentiary basis for a delivery-success reading: a shipped artifact, a quantified velocity superlative, and a named causal unlock. The dimensional reads converge — calm-positive affect, informational power stance, competence/self-enhancement value framing, and the same casual-technical register (FlatTeamShippedVoice) — so the three cohere as one directional read: proof-points assembled without ceremony rather than three unrelated facts. No tension between members; each reinforces the same 'it worked, and here's why' direction.

placements.why: All three expressions report the same sprint's proof-of-delivery for the mechanism this leaf already names: the product capturing decisions at the moment of consensus. 'We shipped the async decision widget' is the artifact that embodies the mechanism; 'The Zephyr integration was the key unlock' names the dependency that lets that capture happen across chat surfaces (Slack, Teams, Discord) without separate plugins, which is exactly how the mechanism scales beyond a single tool; 'Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter' is the flat, unhedged (conviction: claim) execution outcome offered as evidence the mechanism now works in production. None of the three names a new recurring subject on its own — each is a fact/measurement of this sprint (rule 2) — so they join this leaf's support rather than minting their own. The existing leaf's narration ('the product captures the decision at the moment of consensus') already spans exactly this territory; nothing here exceeds or redirects it, so reuse rather than mint or an INSPIRED lineage edge.
